name: Final Tokenized Milestone Escrow
description: Stateful milestone escrow with transferable CashToken role badges, a 2-byte on-chain phase, cooperative release, arbiter resolution, and a time-locked refund. The P2SH32 covenant commits the payout scripts and refund deadline at lock time.

client.name: Client
client.description: Funds the milestone, holds the client badge, releases or refunds.

developer.name: Developer
developer.description: Delivers the milestone and holds the developer badge.

arbiter.name: Arbiter
arbiter.description: Resolves after submission and holds the arbiter badge.

mint.name: Mint Role Token Category
mint.description: Create the one-time minting NFT. Its category becomes the shared category of the state NFT and all role badges.

client.name: Mint
client.description: Generate all role keys and create the minting NFT.

lock.name: Lock Milestone
lock.description: Burn the minting NFT and create the mutable state NFT, three immutable role badges, and the milestone hash receipt.

client.name: Lock
client.description: Sign with the client key and lock the milestone.

submit.name: Submit Milestone
submit.description: Developer badge advances FUNDED (0x00) to SUBMITTED (0x01). The escrow output and developer badge are recreated.

client.name: Submit (single wallet)
client.description: Sign with the developer badge key held by this wallet.

release.name: Release to Developer
release.description: Client badge advances SUBMITTED to RELEASED. The locked amount pays the committed developer P2PKH and the client receives the immutable receipt NFT.

partialRelease.name: Partial Release to Developer
partialRelease.description: Client badge pays part of the current escrow to the developer and keeps the rest in the same escrow, still SUBMITTED. Enter currentEscrowSatoshis, payoutNow, and remainingSatoshis so that payoutNow + remainingSatoshis = currentEscrowSatoshis.

resolveToDeveloper.name: Arbiter Pays Developer
resolveToDeveloper.description: Arbiter badge unilaterally advances SUBMITTED to RELEASED and pays the committed developer P2PKH.

client.name: Resolve (single wallet)
client.description: Sign with the arbiter badge key held by this wallet.

refund.name: Client Refund
refund.description: After the committed deadline, the client badge refunds the locked amount to the committed client P2PKH and creates the immutable REFUNDED receipt.

client.name: Refund
client.description: Sign with the client badge after the deadline.

arbiterRefund.name: Arbiter Refund
arbiterRefund.description: After the committed deadline, the arbiter badge can also refund to the committed client P2PKH.

arbiter.name: Arbiter Refund
arbiter.description: Sign with the arbiter badge after the deadline.

client.name: Arbiter Refund (single wallet)
client.description: Sign with the arbiter badge key held by this wallet.

transferClientBadge.name: Transfer Client Badge
transferClientBadge.description: Transfer the immutable client role badge to a recipient script.

client.name: Transfer
client.description: Sign with the current client badge key.

transferDeveloperBadge.name: Transfer Developer Badge
transferDeveloperBadge.description: Transfer the immutable developer role badge to a recipient script.

developer.name: Transfer
developer.description: Sign with the current developer badge key.

client.name: Transfer (single wallet)
client.description: Sign with the developer badge key held by this wallet.

transferArbiterBadge.name: Transfer Arbiter Badge
transferArbiterBadge.description: Transfer the immutable arbiter role badge to a recipient script.

arbiter.name: Transfer
arbiter.description: Sign with the current arbiter badge key.

client.name: Transfer (single wallet)
client.description: Sign with the arbiter badge key held by this wallet.

mintTransaction.name: Role Category Minted
mintTransaction.description: Created the one-time minting NFT for the escrow category.

lockTransaction.name: Milestone Locked
lockTransaction.description: Burned the minting NFT and created the escrow state and badges.

submitTransaction.name: Milestone Submitted
submitTransaction.description: Developer badge changed the state to SUBMITTED.

releaseTransaction.name: Milestone Released
releaseTransaction.description: Client badge paid the developer and produced the receipt.

partialReleaseTransaction.name: Milestone Partially Released
partialReleaseTransaction.description: Client badge paid part of the locked amount to the developer and recreated the escrow with the rest.

resolveDeveloperTransaction.name: Arbiter Paid Developer
resolveDeveloperTransaction.description: Arbiter badge paid the developer and produced the receipt.

refundTransaction.name: Milestone Refunded
refundTransaction.description: Client badge refunded the milestone after the deadline.

arbiterRefundTransaction.name: Arbiter Refunded
arbiterRefundTransaction.description: Arbiter badge refunded the milestone after the deadline.

transferClientBadgeTransaction.name: Client Badge Transferred
transferClientBadgeTransaction.description: Client badge moved to a recipient locking script.

transferDeveloperBadgeTransaction.name: Developer Badge Transferred
transferDeveloperBadgeTransaction.description: Developer badge moved to a recipient locking script.

transferArbiterBadgeTransaction.name: Arbiter Badge Transferred
transferArbiterBadgeTransaction.description: Arbiter badge moved to a recipient locking script.

mintingOutput.name: Minting NFT
mintingOutput.description: The one-time minting authority. Burned by the lock action.

escrowLockedOutput.name: Escrow (FUNDED)
escrowLockedOutput.description: The locked milestone carrying the mutable 0x0000 state NFT.

escrowSubmittedOutput.name: Escrow (SUBMITTED)
escrowSubmittedOutput.description: The continued escrow carrying the mutable 0x0001 state NFT.

milestoneOutput.name: Milestone hash
milestoneOutput.description: Zero-value OP_RETURN receipt committing the milestone text hash.

developerPayoutOutput.name: Developer payout
developerPayoutOutput.description: The locked amount paid to the developer P2PKH committed at lock.

developerPartialPayoutOutput.name: Developer partial payout
developerPartialPayoutOutput.description: The payoutNow amount paid to the developer P2PKH committed at lock.

escrowRemainingOutput.name: Escrow (remaining, SUBMITTED)
escrowRemainingOutput.description: The remaining locked amount, carried by the same 0x0001 state NFT.

clientPayoutOutput.name: Client payout
clientPayoutOutput.description: The locked amount refunded to the client P2PKH committed at lock.

releaseReceiptOutput.name: Release receipt
releaseReceiptOutput.description: Immutable 0x0002 receipt NFT sent to the client.

refundReceiptOutput.name: Refund receipt
refundReceiptOutput.description: Immutable 0x0003 receipt NFT sent to the client.

badgeTransferOutput.name: Transferred badge
badgeTransferOutput.description: The same immutable badge sent to the recipient locking script.

mintingInput.name: Minting NFT spend
mintingInput.description: Spends and burns the minting NFT at lock time.

escrowInput.name: Escrow spend
escrowInput.description: Spends the state NFT under the P2SH32 milestone covenant.

escrowPartialInput.name: Escrow spend for partial payout
escrowPartialInput.description: Spends the escrow output. Enter its current value as currentEscrowSatoshis; after an earlier partial release this is smaller than lockedSatoshis.

clientBadgeInput.name: Client badge spend
clientBadgeInput.description: Signs with the client badge key.

developerBadgeInput.name: Developer badge spend
developerBadgeInput.description: Signs with the developer badge key.

arbiterBadgeInput.name: Arbiter badge spend
arbiterBadgeInput.description: Signs with the arbiter badge key.

clientLockingScript.name: Client key
clientLockingScript.description: The client funding key. Holds the minting NFT before lock.

clientBadgeLockingScript.name: Client badge holder
clientBadgeLockingScript.description: The P2PKH script that holds the client badge and receives client payouts.

developerBadgeLockingScript.name: Developer badge holder
developerBadgeLockingScript.description: The P2PKH script that holds the developer badge and receives the payout.

arbiterBadgeLockingScript.name: Arbiter badge holder
arbiterBadgeLockingScript.description: The P2PKH script that holds the arbiter badge.

milestoneReturnLockingScript.name: Milestone hash receipt
milestoneReturnLockingScript.description: Zero-value OP_RETURN output that commits the milestone text hash.

escrowLockingScript.name: Milestone escrow covenant
escrowLockingScript.description: The P2SH32 covenant. The state NFT phase selects the action; role badges authorize each branch.

scripts.escrowCovenant:
OP_DROP

  <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT
  OP_SIZE <2> OP_EQUALVERIFY
  <1> OP_SPLIT OP_SWAP OP_BIN2NUM <0> OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_BIN2NUM
  <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_SIZE <33> OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_DROP

  <0> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT
  OP_SIZE <2> OP_EQUAL

  OP_IF
    
  OP_DROP

  <0> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT
  OP_SIZE <2> OP_EQUALVERIFY
  <1> OP_SPLIT OP_SWAP OP_BIN2NUM <0> OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_BIN2NUM

  <0> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
  <0> OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE <0> OP_UTXOBYTECODE OP_EQUALVERIFY
  <0> OP_OUTPUTVALUE <0> OP_UTXOVALUE OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY

  
    <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY <32> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP
    <1> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
  
  
    <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY <32> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP
    <1> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
  
  <1> OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT <0x02> OP_EQUALVERIFY
  <1> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT <0x02> OP_EQUALVERIFY

  OP_SWAP
  OP_0 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
  OP_1 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY

  OP_ELSE
    
  OP_DROP

  <1> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT
  OP_SIZE <2> OP_EQUALVERIFY
  <1> OP_SPLIT OP_SWAP OP_BIN2NUM <0> OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_BIN2NUM

  OP_SWAP
  OP_TOALTSTACK

  OP_DUP <1> OP_NUMEQUAL
  OP_IF
    OP_1 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY

    <1> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
    <0> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_SIZE <0> OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_DROP

    <0> OP_OUTPUTVALUE
    <1> OP_OUTPUTVALUE
    OP_ADD
    <0> OP_UTXOVALUE OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY

    OP_FROMALTSTACK
    <1> OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY

    <0> OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE 
  <0x76a914>
  <$(<developerKey.public_key> OP_HASH160)>
  <0x88ac>
  OP_CAT OP_CAT
 OP_EQUALVERIFY

    <1> OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT <0x01> OP_EQUALVERIFY
  OP_ELSE
    
    <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY <32> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP
    <1> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
  
    <1> OP_OUTPUTVALUE <1000> OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY

    <0> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_SIZE <0> OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_DROP
    <0> OP_OUTPUTVALUE <0> OP_UTXOVALUE OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY

    OP_DUP <2> OP_NUMEQUAL
    OP_IF
      OP_2 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
      OP_FROMALTSTACK
      <1> OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY

      <0> OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE 
  <0x76a914>
  <$(<developerKey.public_key> OP_HASH160)>
  <0x88ac>
  OP_CAT OP_CAT
 OP_EQUALVERIFY
      <1> OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE 
  <0x76a914>
  <$(<clientBadgeKey.public_key> OP_HASH160)>
  <0x88ac>
  OP_CAT OP_CAT
 OP_EQUALVERIFY

      
    <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY <32> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP
    <1> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
  
      
    <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY <32> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP
    <2> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
  
      
    <1> OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT
    OP_DUP <0x01> OP_EQUAL
    OP_SWAP <0x03> OP_EQUAL
    OP_BOOLOR OP_VERIFY
  
      
  <2> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT
  <1> OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT
  OP_EQUALVERIFY

    OP_ELSE
      OP_DUP <3> OP_NUMEQUAL
      OP_IF
        OP_3 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
        OP_FROMALTSTACK
        OP_DUP <0> OP_NUMEQUAL
        OP_SWAP <1> OP_NUMEQUAL
        OP_BOOLOR OP_VERIFY

        <0> OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE 
  <0x76a914>
  <$(<clientBadgeKey.public_key> OP_HASH160)>
  <0x88ac>
  OP_CAT OP_CAT
 OP_EQUALVERIFY
        <1> OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE 
  <0x76a914>
  <$(<clientBadgeKey.public_key> OP_HASH160)>
  <0x88ac>
  OP_CAT OP_CAT
 OP_EQUALVERIFY

        
    <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY <32> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP
    <1> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
  
        
    <0> OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY <32> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP
    <2> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
  
        
    <1> OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT
    OP_DUP <0x01> OP_EQUAL
    OP_SWAP <0x03> OP_EQUAL
    OP_BOOLOR OP_VERIFY
  
        
  <2> OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT
  <1> OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT
  OP_EQUALVERIFY


        <$(<refundDeadline>)> OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY OP_DROP
      OP_ELSE
        OP_0 OP_VERIFY
      OP_ENDIF
    OP_ENDIF
  OP_ENDIF

  OP_ENDIF
  OP_1

dustLimit.name: Dust Limit
dustLimit.description: Minimum satoshis for a token-bearing output.

mintingSatoshis.name: Minting NFT Value
mintingSatoshis.description: Satoshis carried by the one-time minting NFT.

badgeSatoshis.name: Badge Value
badgeSatoshis.description: Satoshis carried by each role badge and each state receipt.

clientKey.name: Client Key
clientKey.description: Funding key generated at mint. Holds the minting NFT before lock.

clientBadgeKey.name: Client Badge Key
clientBadgeKey.description: Client role badge key and committed client payout key.

developerKey.name: Developer Key
developerKey.description: Developer role badge key and committed developer payout key.

tokenCategory.name: Token Category
tokenCategory.description: The CashToken category shared by the state NFT and all badges. At mint it must equal the txid of a funding UTXO at output index 0.

lockedSatoshis.name: Locked Amount
lockedSatoshis.description: The milestone amount locked in the escrow output.

refundDeadline.name: Refund Deadline
refundDeadline.description: UNIX timestamp committed in the covenant and enforced by OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY on refunds.

milestoneHash.name: Milestone Hash
milestoneHash.description: Hash of the milestone text committed in the lock OP_RETURN output.

currentStateCommitment.name: Current State Commitment
currentStateCommitment.description: The escrow input phase: 0000 FUNDED, 0001 SUBMITTED. The covenant derives the next state.

currentEscrowSatoshis.name: Current Escrow Satoshis
currentEscrowSatoshis.description: The value of the escrow input before this partial release. Use the current escrow value, not the original locked amount after an earlier partial release.

payoutNow.name: Payout Now
payoutNow.description: Satoshis to pay the developer in this partial release. payoutNow + remainingSatoshis must equal currentEscrowSatoshis.

remainingSatoshis.name: Remaining Satoshis
remainingSatoshis.description: Satoshis kept in the escrow after this partial release. currentEscrowSatoshis - payoutNow.

badgeCommitment.name: Badge Commitment
badgeCommitment.description: The badge commitment to preserve in a transfer: 01, 02, or 03.

recipientLockingScript.name: Recipient Locking Script
recipientLockingScript.description: The locking script that receives a transferred badge.
